svg.text: Ballast Drill T03h2: option B on the raised plate, then the game view
Plan, south and east elevations at one scale (86 px a tile), to the 5x5 footprint grid. Wet, north direction; a dry drill draws no runs and no fittings.

Plate top 0.85: the highest end ring (S, 0.798) + 0.05. Fittings at ZA 0.42, the pipe in the plate up through a flange on the plate top; B's deck (0.87) merges into the plate; runs lifted 0.19 to axis 1.15.
Game view below: the camera the Blender rig uses (tools/blender/rig.py: 60 degrees, Y stretched by 1/sin 60), so a ground point draws top-down and a height z draws z/2 up the screen; 64 px a tile.

g.text: Option B on the raised plate: plate top 0.85, over the highest end ring (0.80) by 0.05; B's deck (0.87) merges into the plate; the runs lift with it (axis 1.15).
SOUTH ELEVATION (from the south; x right)
EAST ELEVATION (from the east; north right)
on N bastion (drive) (E, W) + N guide column (E, W):
front open on the gear; roof spans to the column
on frame post + frame post + plate:
on the plate top, borne: landing shoulder, N guide foot (E, W),
Runs: on the gallery (r 2.24), axis 1.15 (0.30 over the plate
top, as T03h); on junction risers (flange on the plate top),
face saddles at 1.40, and over each open corner a cast girder
(0.75 to 0.85, ends set in the notch faces, two red-oxide
posts on the ground) with a saddle at the bend. Fittings:
end rings 0.76 to 0.80, all under the plate top (0.85).
Legs: root in the plate's notch face, pad on the ground.

svg.text: red oxide (press frame, drive, rig frame)
base borne by what is under it
other directions' runs and fittings; pipe inside the plate
GAME VIEW (option B2, wet; flat-shaded sketch, 64 px a tile) beside the T03h model render (rig-round-5 cast take, wet, frame 0), same scale and centre

Ticks: the footprint's 5 tiles on the ground. Lit: each part's top in its material's tone; shaded: its faces towards the camera, 0.62 of it; light from the upper left as the rig's sun. Ground shadow flat, 0.42 black.
